## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Created from the mobile simulator audit of MDV-P5-053, findings M-01, M-02, M-10.

Findings and evidence: docs/product-ux-audit/13-mobile-simulator-audit.md, findings M-01, M-02, M-10, with screenshots of synthetic cast data in docs/product-ux-audit/evidence/mobile-simulator.
Components affected: packages/ui-native ListRow, Icon and the tab bar; the clinician Inbox. No new component.
Prerequisites and blocked by: MDV-P5-053. Not in the pilot flow: the pilot runs on the web app.
Clinical sign-off: Not required.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: real data in the apps (MDV-P5-033) and store builds.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a patient row with an allergy or critical flag, when a screen reader reads it, then its accessible name includes the flag's words
- [ ] **AC2.** Given any tab, banner or row with an icon, when the accessibility tree is read on Android and iOS, then no accessible name contains an icon glyph
- [ ] **AC3.** Given two results in the Inbox, when their buttons are read, then each Mark reviewed names its patient and result
- [ ] **AC4.** Given the change, when the ui-native tests run, then a test fails if the flag is dropped from the row's label (mutation check)

## Test notes

- ui-native or app unit tests for the changed behaviour; a simulator check recorded on the PR with synthetic data only.

## Notes / open questions

- Regression risk: low.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
